title: Induction Machine Flux Observer
text: 用于磁场定向控制的感应电机磁通观测器，输入 2 路、输出 4 路；{Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} 指定频率、{Rotor resistance, referred to the stator side (pu)} 指定电阻、{Rotor leakage inductance, referred to the stator side (pu)} 指定电感、{Magnetizing inductance (pu)} 指定电感、{Time constant for dq currents filters (s)} 指定时间常数 1e-4、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间，按实例取值。

params.name: Rotor resistance, referred to the stator side (pu)
Rotor leakage inductance, referred to the stator side (pu)
Time constant for dq currents filters (s)
Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar
